page.layout: One printed page (left page of the opening, page 266). Running head at top centre. Heading "PARTIVM HÆC EST" with subheading "Coherentia." Below them a bracketed tree diagram filling most of the page, with a vertical label "Hujus epistola" on its left. Below the diagram one running paragraph at full width. The right edge of the scan shows a strip of the neighbouring page (its margin text), which is not transcribed.

main_text.head: PARTIVM HÆC EST
Coherentia.
main_text.l: Constantiam in fide Christiàn[?] v. 12. cap. 1. usque ad v. 27.
Simpliciter & absolutè, admonitiones ad pietatem tum speciales tum generales, cap. 4. usque ad v. 10.
Se suamque in suis vinculis Constantiam & patientiam: reliquo capite primo.
Alios: Christum nimirum humillimum & gloriosissimum: & eius discipulos Timoth:& Epaphrod:cap. 2.
Fugiant, nempe circūcisionis non profuturæ, sed potius concisionis ministros: cap. 3.
Gratiarum actio pro Philippensiū beneficiis: à v. 10. cap. 4. usque ad v. 20.
main_text.p: Dispositio capitis primi hæc est: Post salutationem, (v. 1. 2.) Primam principalis tractationis partem,

page.notes: The tree diagram's nesting levels are read from the brace positions and are approximate. The vertical label "Hujus epistola" is hard to read. The Greek word in the Conclusionem line is uncertain. "Christiàn" is partly unclear. The right strip of the neighbouring page is excluded. The paragraph runs on to the next page.
